name: p05-m0-muon
preserved: Ordinary MoE: 16 layers of 64 experts (width 448), top-8.
adaptations: Common RMSNorm/RoPE/SwiGLU cells, softmax top-k with selected-weight normalization and dropless dispatch.
Common Muon for hidden matrices (AdamW for embedding, head, routers, norms and other 1-D parameters) and independently owned input embedding/output head; no original-paper quality or scaling claim.
Publicly reconstructible DCLM replaces the original private corpus; the frozen manifest and tokenizer are separate comparison identities.
Physical active counts name one traversal of unique cells; repeated core calls still incur compute.

The 0.5B geometry continues P1 -> P2, which grew wider faster than deeper (dim 672 -> 1280, 10 -> 12 layers): M0 takes dim 2048 (16 heads of 128) and 16 layers, a multiple of 4 for the 4 + 8 + 4 SMELT split, with expert width 448 for about 0.5B active parameters. M3 keeps p2_smelt's proportions to M0 (width 0.82, head dim 88, 1.4x the experts at 0.9x the width); among those shapes E92/F392 is balanced on all three budgets, within 5% of M0 with dense attention and with P2's measured document pairs. Expert pool and head dimensions differ, so this is a recipe comparison, not a pure loop ablation.

Matrix initialization std=.02, unit norm scales and aux coefficient .01 are P2's; the schedule is Track P2's rule over the whole train split (22888 updates, 458-update linear warmup, constant peak, last 20% linear to 0) and the AdamW or Muon settings are Track P2's.
